purpose: test whether the offline PVE/training UI can load a map without the match service
ui_actions: entered Start Game, switched to PVE (闯关模式)
opened 剧情模式任务, map list and 开始匹配 were visible
clicked 训练, which opened the 靶场 dialog with 进入靶场 / 取消 / X
synthetic clicks on 进入靶场, 取消 and X produced no visible response
a human then clicked 进入靶场 and received the dialog '服务器繁忙中，请稍候重试。'
observed_result: The PVE training entry sends a request to the match service and is rejected when that service is absent. It is not a local map loader.
interpretation: Both the custom-room path and the PVE/training path depend on the remote match/lobby service. There is no offline UI path that loads a map by itself. A local match now requires a service implementation or a verified native map-start path independent of the match service. The synthetic-click silence on the modal is a separate input-routing limitation and is not used as evidence that the button is inert.
cleanup: Run terminated by the coordinator. tools/net_rollback.ps1 reported no guard/client processes, no CODOL WFP filters, a firewall baseline match, and working DNS/loopback/ports.
next: Evaluate whether 319/server319 can serve the 1649370 lobby/match protocol, or capture the client's match request with a loopback service. Do not repeat PVE UI probing as a local map path.
